system: mixed system of common law based on the English model and customary law

constitution.amend: proposed by Parliament; passage requires two-thirds majority vote of Parliament; amendments to constitutional articles, such as the republican form of government, protection of fundamental rights and freedoms, the structure and authorities of the executive and legislative branches, also require two-thirds majority of votes in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of the chief justice and several justices)
courts.judges: judges appointed by the president to serve until age 65
courts.note: in 2017, the Nauruan Government revoked the 1976 High Court Appeals Act, which had allowed appeals beyond the Nauruan Supreme Court, and in 2018, the government formed its own appeals court

suffrage: 20 years of age; universal and compulsory
world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
